title: Solver radius documentation promises a stricter boundary than implemented
description:
The README says a field outside the radius is not solved, but native solving uses radius plus half-field extent only to select catalogue stars and never checks fitted-center angular distance against the requested radius. A solve center may lie outside the stated boundary. Clarify the intended hint contract or enforce the documented fitted-center bound and test a near-boundary field. Source mismatch only; no recognition rerun. Fixed and reverified by the linked repair task; source and runtime limits remain recorded there.
